description: This file defines a registry for command capabilities and invoke commands within an Android application module for the OpenClaw project. It includes data classes and enums representing node capabilities, command availability, and command specifications, as well as a singleton object 'InvokeCommandRegistry' that contains lists of capabilities and commands, methods to find commands by name, and functions to determine advertised capabilities and commands based on runtime flags.

classes.name: NodeRuntimeFlags
classes.description: Data class representing the runtime state flags of the node, indicating which capabilities are enabled or available.

classes.name: InvokeCommandAvailability
classes.description: Enum class representing the different availability conditions for invoke commands.

classes.name: NodeCapabilityAvailability
classes.description: Enum class indicating the availability conditions for node capabilities.

classes.name: NodeCapabilitySpec
classes.description: Data class defining a node capability with a name and availability condition.

classes.name: InvokeCommandSpec
classes.description: Data class defining an invoke command with its name, foreground requirement, and availability.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds an invoke command specification by its name.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities
methods.description: Returns a list of capability names that are advertised based on current runtime flags.

methods.name: advertisedCommands
methods.description: Returns a list of command names that are available based on current runtime flags.
